findings.title: Preserve right alignment in the legacy flexbox fallback
findings.body: The panel now relies on `margin-left: auto` to stay at the right edge, but the `flexbox()` mixin also enables the 2009 `-webkit-box` layout for browsers such as Safari 6. That layout does not distribute free space to auto margins, and the previous `float: right` has been removed. In those browsers the navigation panel sits immediately beside the title/topic information instead of at the right edge. Provide equivalent positioning for the legacy box layout, or retain a working non-flex fallback rather than selecting `-webkit-box`.
